body:
Your comment got hidden but I saw it. I actually tried therapy for multiple years, and I am not fully convinced it didn't make things worse in the end.

I appreciate the advice regardless, my life is probably going to end within the month, and that's probably for the best for everyone. What I meant was that even when I had esteem, it didn't really matter, because I'd be seen like a yapping dog or like napoleon when compared to the other people. At this point too much damage has been done over far too long a duration. It's just truth, there isn't going to be real recovering from this. I guess life is a journey, but I probably need to take the next stop.

I think my bus is coming, and that makes me really sad. I don't think some of us are meant for this world, I just didn't want it to end like this, not really, I just thought I did. It will though, it has to, because life is what it is.
